2818 FEDERAL REGISTER, Tuesday , August 13, 1940
40 Stat. 845, 848 (U.S.C., title 10, sec.  
1341), it is ordered that, subject to valid  
existing rights, all the following-described  
public lands be, and they are hereby,  
withdrawn from all forms of appropria­
tion under the public-land laws, including  
the mining and leasing laws, for the use  
of the War Department as an anti­
aircraft firing range:
Tallahassee Meridian
T. 3 S., R. 31 W.,  
sec. 24, lot 3;  
sec. 25, lot 2;  
sec. 28, lots 1  and 2;  
sec. 30, lot 2;
195.26 acres.
This order supersedes the withdrawal  
made by Executive Order No. 6964 of  
February 5, 1935, as amended, and Ex­
ecutive Order No. 4109 of December 8,  
1924, as to any of the above-described  
lands.
